title: Docs: update rollout policy docs for SLO-based auto-rollback + link runbook/standards
author: Kira Thompson
commits: docs(rollouts): add auto-actions on SLO breach section + FAQ
docs(observability): link rollouts/SLO metrics naming standard; add label/cardinality note
docs(runbooks): add runbook pointer and override/resume references
docs(policies): add JSON examples for templates + per-rollout overrides
docs: fix internal anchors + nav ordering for rollout policies
review_conversation: Paula Mendes: Can we make the first section explicitly say MVP is pause-first in some environments (flagged), and rollback may be disabled by default? Also, add a callout for templates shown in Console.
Kira Thompson (author): Updated intro paragraph to call out feature flag and phased enablement; added note that Console templates mirror policy bundles and may differ by tier/region during rollout.

Sean Gallagher: Please add a very clear “missing/stale monitor” behavior. Oncall needs to know whether we fail-open or fail-closed. Our current guidance is to pause (not rollback) on staleness for MVP.
Kira Thompson (author): Added “Monitor health” section and FAQ entry. Documented default onMissingOrStale=pause and maxStaleness guidance; linked to runbook section ‘Monitor missing/stale’.

Allison Grant: The metric names referenced in the docs must match the observability standard and we should warn about label cardinality if folks try to tag request IDs or prompts. Also add a link to the standard from the examples section.
Kira Thompson (author): Updated metrics references and added a callout on cardinality + disallowed labels; linked the standard in both the main page and examples page.

Benji Okafor: JSON examples are close but please use the schema naming we landed in the policy PR (autoActions, monitorHealth.maxStaleness, debounce.cooldownAfterAction). Also ensure durations are strings.
Kira Thompson (author): Updated both examples to match current schema naming and duration formatting; added a note that keys map to policy bundle fields.
Chloe Martin: Can we add one sentence on where audit events show up in Console (timeline) and that the runbook has the ‘why did we rollback’ pointers?
Kira Thompson (author): Added a short ‘Audit trail & Console visibility’ subsection with links and wording aligned with current UI plan.
Paula Mendes: Approved once JSON example labels are consistent (latency_p99 vs p99_latency).
Kira Thompson (author): Normalized example keys and added a short glossary line. Re-requested review.
release_notes: Internal docs only: adds SLO-based auto-action (pause/rollback) rollout policy documentation, JSON examples, and links to runbook/metrics standards/ADRs. No runtime or control plane behavior changes.
